1.why: All MFA endpoints resolve the account exclusively via accountForSession(session) using session.accountId after requiring an authenticated phase, with no client-supplied account identifiers accepted.

2.why: Each identity code hash is bound to its own pending session (identityCodeHash), marked used after success, and requires a matching accountId, so a code cannot be replayed across users or sessions.

3.why: Enabling MFA in /api/mfa/activate only mutates account.mfa state and never deletes or rotates other existing sessions in the sessions map, so prior sessions remain valid.

4.why: The TOTP secret is stored AES-GCM encrypted (encryptSecret with masterKey) and backup codes are stored as peppered SHA-256 hashes via hashValue, never in plain text.

5.why: All secrets, tokens, and codes are generated with crypto.getRandomValues, including rejection-sampled secureInt for digits and recovery code characters.

6.why: The session cookie is __Host- prefixed with HttpOnly/Secure/SameSite=Strict, and the client keeps CSRF tokens, secrets, and codes only in in-memory variables and textContent, never localStorage or readable cookies.

7.why: Server-side validators (validEmail, validPhone, validOtp, strict recovery-code regex) plus bounded, JSON-only body parsing validate all user input, and storage is in-memory maps with no SQL surface.

8.why: All dynamic values are rendered via textContent or createElement/textContent, and the static innerHTML templates never interpolate user-controlled data, so injected markup cannot execute.

9.why: The application issues no redirects at all and restricts routing to the allowedPaths allow-list, rejecting anything else with 404, so no open redirect exists.

10.why: headersFor sets CSP, HSTS (max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains), X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, X-Frame-Options: DENY, and frame-ancestors 'none' on every response.

11.why: cookieHeader emits the session cookie with HttpOnly, Secure, and SameSite=Strict attributes on both issuance and clearing.

12.why: The server logs nothing, rejects query strings, and returns only generic errors without stack traces, but the client deliberately discloses OTP seeds, current codes, and backup codes to the browser console as 'TEST ONLY' mock delivery.

13.why: Identity codes expire after 5 minutes and are flagged identityUsed on success, TOTP codes are bound to 30-second counters with lastTotpCounter replay rejection, and backup codes are marked used after one redemption.

14.why: Identity, TOTP activation, and recovery verification each track failure counts and impose a 10-minute lockout after 5 failures, returning 429 while locked.

15.why: rotateAuthenticatedSession issues a fresh session id on authentication, sessions enforce 15-minute idle and 8-hour absolute timeouts, and /api/logout deletes the session and expires the cookie.
